strings.en: I'll take ya on myself!
Here comes the great Skull Knight!
Just so ya know, I'm tough!
Ya ran outta luck the second ya got in my sights!
I'll twist ya up nice an' easy!
Outta the way, outta the way!/　The great Skull Knight's comin' through!
I'll drill my terror right into yer bones!
Anyone who gets in my way gets scattered!
Tough luck, punk!
I'm gonna pin ya down right here!
That's my target!
Roa, I'm gonna knock ya flat!
Give it up, Roa!
I'll skewer ya, Roa!
Roa, I ain't lettin' ya get in my way!
Ya got guts, starin' me down like that!
What's with that way of talkin', punk.../　Ya pickin' a fight with me?!
Don't get uppity, ya moron!
Noisy fly. I'll swat ya down!
You think ya can pull the same stuff as/　Lord Dark Brain?! Don't make me laugh, moron!
I'm bad news too, but I ain't/　never seen bad like you before!
What's with that skull? I don't like it!
Where d'ya think yer goin'?!
Ya ain't gettin' away!
Right, my turn!
Ya crossed me, so ya ain't gettin' off easy!
Ya ain't runnin'? Ya got guts!
This one's payback!
I'll settle this in 30 seconds!
Don't go spacin' out on me!
I'll let ya off with this much for today!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Can't be helped. Let's call it here.
Ouch! That one went right to the bone!
I ain't plannin' to bury my bones in this world!
That's some pretty nasty stuff yer pullin'.
This... ain't no joke.
Mmph! That didn't hurt, moron!
Mess with me an' I'll wreck ya, punk!
What the hell d'ya think yer doin', punk?!
Aw, no! I took that one full-on!
Like I'd let that moron trash my plans!
I hate ya to the bone, Roa! I'll crack yer skull later!
Mimickin' the way I talk!/　That ticks me off!
I-It's too early to show ya how a man dies!!
Outta my way, ring-head!
Knock it off, ya gaudy ring-head!
Pretty good for such a skinny body!
Tch, that armor's a real pain.
Wearin' a skull ain't just for show, huh!
That moron's as much of a pain as Compati Kaiser!
I'll yank out every one of them spikes!
Tch, actin' like some kinda final boss!
Well, not bad, I guess.
Oh, not bad.
Oho, gettin' full of yerself now.
That was fun! Try it one more time!
Ya got guts, hittin' me!
Hmph, guess ya don't value yer life much.
Hmm? I failed to block that.
Ya think ya can beat me with that? Gimme a break!
What, Roa? That all ya got?
Well, we go way back./　I'll let this much slide, Roa.
I'll shove a spear up yer nose, punk!
Thought ya were just a tagalong,/　but ya ain't half bad.
Now ya really made me mad... I won't forgive ya!
Hmph, I'll rip that ring off ya later!
Looks like ya ain't just flashy on the outside.
Scrawny as ya are, ya sure land yer hits.
Hmph, looks like that armor ain't just for show.
Red as he is, weak as he is,/　yer a match for Compati Kaiser.
Not bad for a Compati knockoff.
What's with them wings?
So the Compati knockoff got a bit stronger.
Is that skull just for show?
Pullin' the same stunt as Fatso...
Not bad, Spiky!
That shiny gold ring blinded me, so I couldn't dodge.
What's that?
That's ya bein' serious? Don't make me laugh!
Yer no match for me.
Hm? Did somethin' touch me?
Ain't even worth dodgin'.
Who d'ya think I am?!
That's it? No big deal.
Put some more effort in!
Ain't you a cute little thing!
What's up, Roa? Yer weaker than before.
What're ya playin' at, Roa?
What, punk? All bark an' no bite?
Hmph, ya can't hold a candle to Lord Dark Brain!
What, is that ring just for show?
Carryin' a dragon on yer back, an' that's it?
What's somebody skinnier than me gonna do?
Still weak, even in armor.
A skull don't suit a weakling.
Ya got spikes, but yer weak, punk.
Haulin' around somethin' that fancy, an' that's it?
Ya missed, moron!
Where ya lookin'?!
What a lame-o!
Don't get cocky, ya two-bit villain!
Whiffed it!
Too bad!
Come back when yer ready!
Roa, I'm over here!
Didn't hurt!
What a pathetic attack!
What the heck is that?!
Oho, wastin' yer time.
What, all outta tricks?
Hmph, I'll let ya off this time.
Oho, quick on yer feet when runnin', huh.
Am I that scary to ya?!
Tch, can't be helped.
Too early to let yer guard down!
That prey's mine, Fatso!
Crys, leave the rest to me!
Fine, I'll lend ya a hand, Roa!
Ya moron! Like I'd let ya!
Ya owe me for this one, Fatso!
Back off, Crys!
This favor's gonna cost ya big!
I'll go all out!
Oho, there's still a sucker left!
There!
I'm gonna hit ya!
Take this!
It's Dark Mist!
This ain't no ordinary fog!
Here I go!
Criscal Beam!
I'll blow ya away!
I'll wreck ya with my Skull Lancer!
This spear hurts like crazy!
Take that!
How's that?!
I'll skewer ya!!
Gotcha!
Hyaah!
I'll ram it in deep!!
This sends ya to the next world!
Right, lemme show ya my finisher!
Brace yerself!
I'll knock ya flyin'!
Now the real show starts!
Skyral Lancer!
This'll finish ya in one!!
Oho, what a flashy firework that was.
But it ain't free!
Mine!
Take a kick!
This'll lay ya out!
Get lost!!
Smashed to bits, bones an' all!
